report.headline: For SA1 half-hour ending 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST, the forecast run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608200830_20260820080131 (issued 2026-08-19T21:57:01Z) gave POE50 1594.0 MW and the measured operational demand was 1567.0 MW.
summary: Forecast run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608200830_20260820080131 (issued 2026-08-19T21:57:01Z) gave POE10 = 1663.0 MW [ev0554], POE50 = 1594.0 MW [ev0550], POE90 = 1525.0 MW [ev0555] for target end 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST.
Measured operational demand for the same interval (2026-08-20 08:00 ACST) was 1567.0 MW [ev0551]; the forecast error (POE50 − actual) is 27.0 MW [ev0552], i.e. 1.72% [ev0553].
The run/actual pair for the 24‑half‑hour review yields a mean absolute error (MAE) of 149.81 MW [ev0676] (see forecast_mae_evidence_id).

possible_explanations.statement: The actual being within the run's POE90–POE10 band may reflect routine forecast uncertainty in the short lead period for this interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare intraday weather and solar generation observations for 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST with the model inputs used for the run.

possible_explanations.statement: The small positive error (POE50 − actual = 27.0 MW) might reflect minor differences in realised behind‑the‑meter or distributed PV output compared with what the forecast used.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check measured distributed PV or WDR estimates around 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST and compare to the forecast inputs for that run.
